podcast.body: A song from Matthew Good's 2007 album, `Hospital Music`. A live version of `Born Losers` was featured on the 2008 live album `Live at Massey Hall`. "Matt Good with Born Losers from his 2007 album, Hospital Music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Matt Good: In His Own Words - Part 2

podcast.body: This song was released as a single from Matthew Good's album *Hospital Music*, which was born out of his personal battles with bipolar disorder and his journey toward understanding and managing his mental health. "And from that, here's a single called Born Loser."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
